world.title: 'Lake America': Trump floats plan to rename Lake Ontario amid escalating US-Canada trade row
world.summary: President Donald Trump announced on Tuesday that the United States is "giving serious consideration" to renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America. This proposal comes amid an escalating trade dispute between the U.S. and Canada. The suggestion reflects ongoing tensions in trade relations, although further details on the potential name change or its implications have not been provided.

world.title: Why Rohingya refugees are protesting in Cox’s Bazar, 9 years after genocide
world.summary: Hundreds of Rohingya refugees protested in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, on the ninth anniversary of the genocide against them in Myanmar. They demanded justice and the right to return home amid significant aid cuts in Bangladesh and forced evictions in Malaysia and India. The gathering highlighted ongoing struggles faced by over one million Rohingya displaced since the violence began.

world.title: ‘We are under attack’: US military aircraft lands in Russia, sparks wild theories
world.summary: A US Air Force Boeing C-17 Globemaster III military transport aircraft landed at Moscow's Vnukovo Airport on Tuesday, according to AFP. This heavy strategic transport aircraft is designed for rapid movement of troops, vehicles, and large cargo over long distances. The landing has sparked various theories regarding its purpose and implications amid ongoing tensions between the US and Russia.

business.title: Varun Beverages forays into alcohol business, names ex-Diageo executive Prathmesh Mishra to lead new unit
business.summary: Varun Beverages is entering the alcoholic drinks market by establishing a new subsidiary, appointing former Diageo executive Prathmesh Mishra to lead the venture. This expansion marks a significant diversification for the company. Additionally, Varun Beverages plans a joint venture in Tunisia for beverage production. These strategic initiatives are contingent upon obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals.

business.title: JSW Motors Trademarks Seven Names For Its Upcoming Cars
business.summary: JSW Motors, a new Indian carmaker, is set to launch its vehicles during the upcoming festive season. The company has trademarked seven unique names for its upcoming cars, moving away from traditional family or numerical naming conventions. This marks the debut of a homegrown car manufacturer in India after several decades, signaling a new phase in the automotive industry.

business.title: India to exempt high-tech industries from BIS certification requirement, says Piyush Goyal
business.summary: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced on August 25 that the government will establish a framework to exempt high-tech industries from Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification requirements. This initiative aims to facilitate exemptions at the sector, company, product, or project level, targeting industries such as semiconductors and artificial intelligence to promote innovation and growth.

technology.title: Garmin Fenix 9 is here, and it’s brighter and thinner than its predecessor
technology.summary: Garmin has announced the release of the Fenix 9 and Fenix 9 Pro watches, featuring a brighter display and a thinner design compared to their predecessors. The new models aim to enhance user experience with improved functionality and style. Detailed specifications and features have been shared, highlighting advancements in technology and design for outdoor enthusiasts and fitness users.

technology.title: Samsung makes switching to Galaxy Z Fold 8 seamless, here’s how
technology.summary: Samsung has launched an update to facilitate switching to the Galaxy Z Fold 8. With One UI 9, the Smart Switch app enables users to transfer data seamlessly from both iOS and Android devices. This enhancement aims to simplify the setup process for new users, making it easier to transition to the Galaxy Z Fold 8 without significant hassle.

technology.title: Microsoft Research Integrates Skala AI Into CP2K Platform
technology.summary: Microsoft Research has integrated its Skala AI model into the open-source CP2K software, enhancing the platform's capabilities for high-accuracy simulations of large molecular systems. This integration aims to improve computational efficiency and accuracy in molecular modeling, benefiting researchers in various scientific fields. The Skala model, developed by Microsoft Research AI for Science, focuses on exchange-correlation functionals.

sports.title: India tighten hold on Colombo Test despite Dinusha fightback
sports.summary: India strengthened their position in the Colombo Test as Prasidh Krishna and Manav Suthar each took three wickets. Sri Lanka concluded the third day at 265/8, trailing by 238 runs. Despite a resilient effort from the Sri Lankan team, they lost six wickets throughout the day, leaving them in a challenging position as the match progresses.

sports.title: Sunil Gavaskar tears into Mackay pitch and ICC referees; calls out 'staggering double standards': 'Brazen hypocrisy'
sports.summary: Sunil Gavaskar criticized the inconsistency in assessing Test pitches, highlighting that four matches in Australia concluded within two days without facing similar scrutiny as Indian pitches. He described this disparity as "staggering double standards" and "brazen hypocrisy." Gavaskar's comments, published in his Sportstar column, emphasize the need for uniformity in evaluating pitch conditions across different countries.

sports.title: 'You're just wasting time bro': Sarfaraz Khan's sledging skills go viral during IND vs SL 2nd Test - Watch
sports.summary: Sarfaraz Khan, substituting for the injured Rishabh Pant, gained attention during Day 3 of India's second Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo. His vocal presence as a short leg fielder included notable sledging, which seemed to unsettle Sri Lankan players. Videos of his interactions quickly went viral, showcasing his engaging style and contribution to the match atmosphere.

health.title: Your blood pressure could be rising because of these 7 everyday habits you may think are completely harmless
health.summary: Blood pressure typically increases due to repeated everyday habits rather than isolated incidents. Factors such as excessive salt intake, prolonged sitting, inadequate sleep, regular alcohol consumption, chronic stress, certain medications, and gradual weight gain contribute to this rise. Dr. Sameer Bhate emphasizes that these habits can silently elevate cardiovascular risk, often without noticeable symptoms of high blood pressure.

health.title: Popular weight loss drug linked to unexpected mental health benefits
health.summary: Research indicates that semaglutide, a popular weight loss drug, may offer unexpected mental health benefits, particularly for individuals with bipolar disorder. The study found a correlation between semaglutide use and reduced hospitalizations for these patients. However, researchers emphasize the need for further testing to confirm these findings and understand the potential implications for mental health treatment.

health.title: Brain region responsible for language might be more resilient to ageing than others: Study
health.summary: A new study indicates that the brain region responsible for language in older adults may show activity levels similar to those in younger adults. In contrast, the decision-making brain system appears to exhibit differences between the two age groups. This suggests that the language-related brain area may be more resilient to the effects of aging than other regions.

science.title: Scientists built a tiny 'rainbow on a chip' that could help future 6G networks carry more signals at once
science.summary: Scientists at Loughborough University, in collaboration with an international research team, have developed a miniature "rainbow on a chip." This innovation can produce multiple precisely spaced light frequencies simultaneously. The technology aims to enhance future 6G networks by enabling them to carry more signals concurrently, potentially improving data transmission capabilities and overall network efficiency.

science.title: Did Sun re-shaped Earth? NASA revealed a surprising secret between the Sun and Earth's climate history
science.summary: NASA-backed research indicates that the Sun's ancient activity may have significantly influenced Earth's climate and habitability over billions of years. This study suggests a connection between solar events and changes in Earth's environment, proposing that the Sun's history could be intertwined with the planet's climate evolution. These findings could reshape our understanding of Earth's climatic history.

science.title: Runaway supermassive black hole may be the result of a violent cosmic collision
science.summary: A supermassive black hole, designated RBH-1, is moving away from its galaxy at nearly 1,000 kilometers per second, leaving a trail of star formation spanning 202,000 light-years. Computer models suggest this runaway motion resulted from a violent merger between two galaxies, which propelled the black hole into its current trajectory, providing insights into cosmic collisions and black hole dynamics.

entertainment.title: Spider Man Brand New Day cross 2 crore footfalls in India, Third Hollywood film in history to enter the coveted club
entertainment.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has surpassed 2 crore footfalls in India, grossing approximately Rs. 570 crore (Rs. 471 crore nett) in 26 days. It is now the third Hollywood film to achieve this milestone. Later this year, Avengers: Doomsday is anticipated to join this exclusive club and may potentially challenge Titanic's long-standing box office record.

entertainment.title: Gandhari trailer: Blind mother Taapsee Pannu channels her inner goddess, goes on 'mahayudh' to save her daughter
entertainment.summary: The trailer for Taapsee Pannu's upcoming film "Gandhari" has garnered positive reactions from fans. The action thriller focuses on a blind mother’s fight to save her daughter. Viewers expressed excitement, calling the trailer promising and interesting, with comments highlighting Pannu's consistent performance in good films. The film aims to showcase a mother's resilience in challenging circumstances.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, August 26, 2026: Your confidence and ambition are likely to be particularly strong tomorrow
entertainment.summary: On August 26, 2026, horoscopes indicate heightened confidence and ambition for all sun signs. Individuals may experience feelings of restriction due to doubts or circumstances, but the situation may be more manageable than it seems. It is advised to challenge beliefs that foster feelings of powerlessness, as a change in perspective could reveal new options and opportunities.
